title: Another book is free
note: Starting a book for another child opens the same step as first run, with no Plus gate (D-082, D-083): the first two letters are one pool across every book, and the gate is at Keep, not here. Nothing is chosen for the person: "Add this book" waits, and the line above it says why.
text: Add a child Who is this book for? Name Twins or more? Each child gets their own book. Add a name to continue.
lines: Twins or more? Each child gets their own book.
